annotations.title: Chord finder (name a chord from frets)

description: Name a guitar chord from the frets played in standard tuning (low E to high e). Same engine as https://sandymusiclab.com/tools/chord-finder/. Frets as "x32010" or "x-3-2-0-1-0" (x = muted). Returns the best name, alternates, notes and a shareable URL.

frets.description: Six strings low E to high e, e.g. "x32010" (C) or "x-3-2-0-1-0"
